capabilities: Display folders side by side with expanded contents in their own column
Show full file and folder names on hover
Show folder counts or file dates below names after a one-second delay
Position the hover label left, center, or right of the cursor
Restore the default file explorer when the plugin is disabled
extras: Tested only on Obsidian 1.13.7 for Windows with the default theme; mobile and older versions are untested, and large expanded folders may use more memory.
intentEvidence: Disable the plugin to return to the normal file explorer.
problem: Obsidian's default file explorer nests expanded folders in a single column, so wide folder structures become long and hard to scan.
summary: File explorer view that shows folders side by side in two columns, keeping each expanded folder's contents in its own column.
